payload.summary: Design a flanged bushing with a sliding-fit bore for a 20 mm shaft and a 4-hole M4 bolt circle on the flange.

payload.request_verbatim: Design a flanged bushing with a sliding-fit bore for a 20 mm shaft and a 4-hole M4 bolt circle on the flange.

deliverables.name: flanged-bushing
deliverables.title: Flanged bushing
deliverables.description: Single flanged bushing: cylindrical body with integral flange; through bore for a 20 mm shaft at sliding fit; flange with a 4-hole M4 bolt circle.

acceptance_criteria.text: Through bore accepts a 20 mm shaft with sliding (clearance) fit — bore ID per a stated ISO fit class for 20 mm (e.g. H7 or equivalent sliding class)

check.pass_rule: bore_id within selected sliding-fit tolerance band for 20 mm shaft

acceptance_criteria.text: Flange has exactly four holes sized for M4 fasteners (clearance for free-fit M4 bolts/screws)

check.pass_rule: hole_count == 4 and hole_diameter in M4 free-fit clearance range

acceptance_criteria.text: The four M4 holes lie on a single bolt circle, equally spaced at 90°

check.pass_rule: four hole centers co-radial within tol and angular spacing 90° ± tol

acceptance_criteria.text: Part is a flanged bushing: cylindrical bush body with an integral radial flange at one end

check.pass_rule: outline shows body cylinder + flange; flange OD > body OD

assumptions.text: Deliverable is the CAD part only (no 2D drawing, CAM, or FEA requested).
assumptions.basis: request verbs only 'Design' and names one product noun; no drawing/gcode/analysis mentioned

assumptions.text: Sliding fit means a standard clearance class for a 20 mm shaft (e.g. ISO H7 bore on h6/g6 shaft); exact class to be chosen by spec_writer.
assumptions.basis: user said 'sliding-fit' without naming ISO class

assumptions.text: Flange bolt-circle diameter, flange OD/thickness, body OD/length, and overall envelope are not specified — engineering defaults will be proposed and must be confirmed.
assumptions.basis: request states only shaft size and M4×4 bolt circle, not BCD or envelope

assumptions.text: Material not specified; will follow project/default stock (e.g. bronze/oilite or 6061) chosen later — not fixed here.
assumptions.basis: no material in request; bushings often sintered bronze but not stated

assumptions.text: M4 holes are plain clearance through-holes (not tapped) for bolts clamping the flange to a mating surface.
assumptions.basis: typical flanged-bushing mounting; 'M4 bolt circle' implies bolt clearance

assumptions.text: Single piece, quantity 1; no mating shaft or housing parts in scope.
assumptions.basis: request asks only for the bushing

ambiguities.text: Bolt circle diameter (BCD) and flange size not given — different BCDs produce different parts.
options: propose common BCD for M4×4 (e.g. ~32–40 mm) and confirm

ambiguities.text: Body length, body OD, flange thickness not given.
options: propose short general-purpose proportions and confirm

ambiguities.text: Exact sliding-fit ISO class (H7/H8/etc.) not named.
Material and manufacturing process (machined bar vs sintered bronze bushing) not stated.

payload.notes: One primary deliverable (the part). Blocking ambiguities on envelope/BCD must be resolved or defaulted with needs_confirm before detailed design; intake does not invent dimensions.
